sentences.sk: Anna ide po práci do obchodu s potravinami.
sentences.en: After work Anna goes to the grocery store.

sentences.sk: Doma už nemá mlieko ani chlieb.
sentences.en: At home she has no milk or bread left.

sentences.sk: Pred obchodom vytiahne z tašky krátky zoznam.
sentences.en: In front of the store she takes a short list out of her bag.

sentences.sk: Na zozname sú mlieko, chlieb, paradajky a jablká.
sentences.en: The list has milk, bread, tomatoes, and apples.

sentences.sk: Najprv vezme košík pri vchode.
sentences.en: First she takes a basket by the entrance.

sentences.sk: Potom nájde čerstvý chlieb na polici.
sentences.en: Then she finds fresh bread on a shelf.

sentences.sk: Pri zelenine vidí červené paradajky a zelené uhorky.
sentences.en: By the vegetables she sees red tomatoes and green cucumbers.

sentences.sk: Uhorky nie sú na zozname, ale Anna ich má rada.
sentences.en: Cucumbers are not on the list, but Anna likes them.

sentences.sk: Vezme dve uhorky a štyri paradajky.
sentences.en: She takes two cucumbers and four tomatoes.

sentences.sk: Pri ovocí vyberie tri veľké jablká.
sentences.en: By the fruit she chooses three large apples.

sentences.sk: Mlieko je v chladničke na konci obchodu.
sentences.en: The milk is in a refrigerator at the end of the store.

sentences.sk: Anna vezme liter mlieka a ide k pokladni.
sentences.en: Anna takes a liter of milk and goes to the checkout.

sentences.sk: Pred ňou stojí starší pán s plným košíkom.
sentences.en: An older man with a full basket stands in front of her.

sentences.sk: Anna chvíľu čaká a pozerá na svoj zoznam.
sentences.en: Anna waits a moment and looks at her list.

sentences.sk: Zistí, že zabudla kúpiť maslo.
sentences.en: She realizes she forgot to buy butter.

sentences.sk: Rýchlo sa vráti k chladničke a vezme maslo.
sentences.en: She quickly returns to the refrigerator and takes butter.

sentences.sk: Pri pokladni zaplatí kartou.
sentences.en: At the checkout she pays by card.

sentences.sk: Predavačka jej podá účtenku a usmeje sa.
sentences.en: The cashier gives her a receipt and smiles.

sentences.sk: Anna si dá nákup do tašky a ide domov.
sentences.en: Anna puts her groceries in her bag and goes home.

sentences.sk: Večer si z paradajok pripraví jednoduchý šalát.
sentences.en: In the evening she makes a simple salad from the tomatoes.

glossary.note: Instrumental plural after s; obchod s potravinami means grocery store.
Masculine noun; here a shopping list.

questions.explanationEn: The list contains milk, bread, tomatoes, and apples.
She realizes she forgot the butter.
